info.title: Backend Autopilot -- Deterministic Task Execution Contract
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the deterministic execution response returned by superadmin_task_execute (and superadmin_task_rebase_onto_current_base) over the Superadmin MCP JSON-RPC endpoint. A caller issuing 'realize task X' must receive either exactly one durable jobId/runId pair, or a structured blocking reason -- never partial or pseudo-progress. This document is deliberately scoped to that response contract, not the full MCP tool surface.

post.description: Queues a fixed GitHub Actions execution using a registered resource ID and semantic file changes. operationId is mandatory and globally replay-safe: repeating an already-used operationId for the same tool/project never redispatches -- it returns the existing execution's status only.

200.description: Either an accepted deterministic execution or a structured DomainError. Both are always well-formed JSON-RPC results; HTTP 200 does not by itself imply success -- inspect isError.

operationId.description: Mandatory, globally replay-safe within (actor, tool, projectId): identical operationId always returns the original execution's status rather than redispatching.

resourceId.description: Must resolve to an ACTIVE GITHUB_REPOSITORY resource registered for this exact project (see repository-guard.ts).

DeterministicExecutionResult.description: The only shape a caller may treat as accepted progress. A response missing jobId or runId is never valid -- resolveMergeableCommit-style callers, and the coordinator itself, treat that as EXECUTION_IDENTITY_MISSING instead of silently succeeding.

jobId.description: Always equal to job.id; never empty.

runId.description: Always equal to run.id; never empty.

mode.description: DISPATCHED: a new GitHub Actions execution was just queued. STATUS_ONLY: operationId was already used -- this is a replay, and nothing was redispatched.

text.description: JSON-encoded { error: { code, message, details } }; details.blockingReport is present whenever the failure is one this contract requires to be reported as structured evidence rather than progress language.

BlockingReport.description: Structured, machine-actionable evidence for why execution did not (and will not, without a fresh operationId or human action) make progress. Present in DomainError.details.blockingReport for every code below.

code.description: EXECUTION_IDENTITY_MISSING: a persisted job/run pair lost its durable identity (fails closed rather than reporting pseudo-success). WRITE_DISPATCH_UNAVAILABLE: the async execution dispatcher is unreachable -- the job/run are created but immediately terminalized (job BLOCKED, run FAILED), never left implying in-flight progress. CANON_OR_API_CONFLICT: the implementation plan violates ArchitectureGuard canon/API rules and was rejected before any execution was queued.

remediation.description: The concrete next step -- e.g. restore the dispatcher and use a fresh operationId, or resolve the reported canon/API violation and re-plan.

evidence.description: Present for CANON_OR_API_CONFLICT: the ArchitectureGuard violations that caused the rejection.
